```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(mirt)
library(rlang)
library(levantemodels)

source(here("02_score_data/02_extract_irt/registry_helper.R"))
```

```{r}
# specify which tasks use rasch vs 2pl models
scalar_rasch_tasks <- c("hf", "math", "matrix", "mg", "sds", "trog")
scalar_2pl_tasks <- c("mrot", "tom")
configural_rasch_tasks <- c("vocab", "pa", "swr")

# load task data
task_data_nested <- read_rds(here("01_fetched_data/task_data_nested.rds"))

# specify which models to fit for rasch/2pl
models_multigroup_rasch <- tibble(
  nfact = 1,
  itemtype = "Rasch",
  invariance = c("configural", "scalar")
)
models_multigroup_2pl <- tibble(
  nfact = 1,
  itemtype = "2PL",
  invariance = c("configural", "scalar")
)
models_pooled_rasch <- tibble(
  nfact = 1,
  itemtype = "Rasch"
)
```

```{r}
# load ages from runs
min_age <- 5
max_age <- 13
runs_filtered_trials <- read_rds(here("01_fetched_data/runs_filtered_trials.rds"))
run_ages <- runs_filtered_trials |>
  select(run_id, age) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= min_age, age <= max_age)

# add ages and age groups to task data
task_data_age <- task_data_nested |>
  unnest(data) |>
  inner_join(run_ages) |>
  # 2 age groups, split at middle of range
  mutate(age_group = cut(age, include.lowest = TRUE,
                         breaks = seq(min_age, max_age, length.out = 3)) |>
           # transform group strings to only letters and underscore
           as.character() |> str_remove_all("[\\(\\)\\[\\]]") |> str_replace(",", "_")) |>
  nest(data = -c(age_group, item_task))

task_data_age_scalar <- task_data_age |>
  filter(item_task %in% c(scalar_rasch_tasks, scalar_2pl_tasks))

task_data_age_configural <- task_data_age |>
  filter(item_task %in% configural_rasch_tasks)
```

```{r}
# registry directory for age invariance models
regdir_age <- here("02_scoring_outputs", "model_registry_age")

# fit multigroup rasch models
scalar_rasch_tasks |>
  walk(\(task) fit_task_models_multigroup(
    task_data = task_data_age_scalar,
    models = models_multigroup_rasch,
    priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3)),
    task = task,
    group = age_group,
    registry_dir = regdir_age)
  )

# fit multigroup 2pl models
scalar_2pl_tasks |>
  walk(\(task) fit_task_models_multigroup(
    task_data = task_data_age_scalar,
    models = models_multigroup_2pl,
    priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3)),
    task = task,
    group = age_group,
    registry_dir = regdir_age)
  )

# fit pooled rasch models
task_age_groups <- expand_grid(task = configural_rasch_tasks,
                               age_group = unique(task_data_aged$age_group))
walk2(task_age_groups$task, task_age_groups$age_group,
      \(tsk, grp) fit_task_models_pooled(
        task_data = task_data_age_configural,
        models = models_pooled_rasch,
        priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3)),
        task = tsk,
        subset_var = age_group,
        subset_val = grp,
        registry_dir = regdir_age))
```

```{r}
# load and code age models
mods_age <- list_models(regdir_age) |> load_models(regdir_age)
mods_age_coded <- mods_age |> code_models() |> mutate(BIC = map_dbl(mod_rec, BIC))

# extract BICs
mods_age_bic <- mods_age_coded |>
  filter(subset == "overlap_items") |>
  select(model_set, task, itemtype, nfact, invariance, BIC)

# compare BICs by invariance
mods_age_bic |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = invariance, values_from = BIC) |>
  mutate(delta_bic = configural - scalar)

# create mirt objects out of model records for multigroup models
mods_age_multigroup <- mods_age_coded |>
  filter(subset == "all_items") |>
  mutate(mod = map(mod_rec, model_from_record)) |>
  mutate(group = map(mod, \(m) m@Data$groupNames),
         group_models = map(mod, multigroup_extract_groups)) |>
  select(model_set, subset, group, task, itemtype, nfact, invariance, group_models) |>
  unnest(cols = c("group_models", "group"))

# extract reliabilities for multigroup models
mods_age_multigroup_rxx <- mods_age_multigroup |>
  mutate(scores = map(group_models, \(m) fscores(m, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = TRUE)),
         empirical_rxx = map_dbl(scores, empirical_rxx)) |>
  select(model_set, task, itemtype, nfact, invariance, group, empirical_rxx)

# compare reliabilities by age group for multigroup models
mods_age_multigroup_rxx |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = empirical_rxx)

# create mirt objects out of model records for separate by age group models
mods_age_configural <- mods_age_coded |>
  filter(model_set == "by_age_group") |>
  mutate(mod = map(mod_rec, model_from_record))

# extract reliabilities for separate by age group models
mods_age_configural_rxx <- mods_age_configural |>
  mutate(scores = map(mod, \(m) fscores(m, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = TRUE)),
         empirical_rxx = map_dbl(scores, empirical_rxx)) |>
  select(model_set, task, itemtype, nfact, invariance, group = subset, empirical_rxx)

# compare reliabilities by age group for separate by age group models
mods_age_configural_rxx |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = empirical_rxx)
```

```{r}
# load sex/gender from mental rotation
sex_data_cleaned <- read_rds(here("../papers/mental-rotation", "data/sex_data_cleaned.rds"))

# add sex to task data
task_data_sex <- task_data_nested |>
  unnest(data) |>
  inner_join(sex_data_cleaned) |>
  nest(data = -c(sex, item_task))

task_data_sex_scalar <- task_data_sex |>
  filter(item_task %in% c(scalar_rasch_tasks, scalar_2pl_tasks))

task_data_sex_configural <- task_data_sex |>
  filter(item_task %in% configural_rasch_tasks)
```

```{r}
# registry directory for sex invariance models
regdir_sex <- here("02_scoring_outputs", "model_registry_sex")

# fit multigroup rasch models
scalar_rasch_tasks |>
  walk(\(task) fit_task_models_multigroup(
    task_data = task_data_sex_scalar,
    models = models_multigroup_rasch,
    priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3)),
    task = task,
    group = sex,
    registry_dir = regdir_sex)
  )

# fit multigroup 2pl models
scalar_2pl_tasks |>
  walk(\(task) fit_task_models_multigroup(
    task_data = task_data_sex_scalar,
    models = models_multigroup_2pl,
    priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3)),
    task = task,
    group = sex,
    registry_dir = regdir_sex)
  )

# fit pooled rasch models
task_sex_groups <- expand_grid(task = configural_rasch_tasks,
                               sex = unique(task_data_sex$sex))
walk2(task_sex_groups$task, task_sex_groups$sex,
      \(tsk, grp) fit_task_models_pooled(
        task_data = task_data_sex_configural,
        models = models_pooled_rasch,
        priors = list(d = c("norm", 0, 3)),
        task = tsk,
        subset_var = sex,
        subset_val = grp,
        registry_dir = regdir_sex))
```

```{r}
subgroup_bic <- bind_rows(
  mods_age_bic |> nest(bic = c(invariance, BIC)),
  mods_sex_bic |> nest(bic = c(invariance, BIC))
)

subgroup_rxx <- bind_rows(mods_age_multigroup_rxx, mods_age_configural_rxx,
                          mods_sex_multigroup_rxx, mods_sex_configural_rxx) |>
  nest(rxx = c(group, empirical_rxx))

mod_subgroup_stats <- full_join(subgroup_rxx, subgroup_bic) |>
  # mutate(model_set = str_remove(model_set, "multigroup_")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(model_set, names = c("model_type", "group_var"),
                       delim = "_", too_many = "merge") |>
  mutate(model_type = model_type |> replace_values("by" ~ "singlegroup"),
         invariance = invariance |> replace_values("" ~ "configural"))
  # rename(group_var = model_set) |>

write_rds(mod_subgroup_stats, here("02_scoring_outputs/mod_subgroup_stats.rds"))
```
